package.name: g1_map_manager
package.description: Map management for the Unitree G1: named, versioned maps with a manual cross-map topology, gateway-seeded relocalization, map-scoped nav-point authoring, non-destructive offline editing, and a single map-aware navigation entry that delegates single-map legs to g1_nav. ROS-free core (version store, topology routing, overlay, nav-point anchoring, mode machine) + thin ROS nodes.
package.author: Rohan
